description: TODO for the project owner: real-world long-tail questions with verified answers. Nothing here is filled in on purpose - answers must come from a source you checked, not from a model. For each item fill expected (keywords that must appear, or a number), forbidden (plausible wrong answers), source (URL or citation) and set ready to true. Items with ready=false are skipped by the benchmark. Prefer questions a model is likely to get wrong: lesser-known people, exact dates, counts, recent changes.
